name: gateway_kartplex_t1_landmarks

metadata.crs: WGS84 (EPSG:4326), lon/lat order per GeoJSON spec
metadata.units: meters for any derived distance/bearing properties
metadata.provenance: Seed landmarks AND corner apexes hand-placed on Google Maps satellite imagery by the user. NOT survey-grade. Satellite imagery is offset from the phone GPS by several meters.
metadata.intended_use: Seeds for a kart-telemetry pipeline (Sensor Logger GPS). Snap each landmark to the nearest point on the real GPS track and validate by data before use. Do NOT treat any coordinate, vertex, length, or bearing as exact.

validation.start_finish_gate: validate by minimizing lap-time RMSE across crossings
validation.pit_exit_entrance: validate via speed/heading discontinuities on out-/in-laps
validation.general: every point is APPROXIMATE; GPS track is geometry truth

_README: APPROXIMATE / ROUGH SKETCH ONLY. Points and paths were hand-placed on Google Maps satellite imagery to convey LAYOUT, ROUTING, and corner SEQUENCE, not precise geometry. They are NOT survey data and NOT the actual driven line. DO NOT treat any coordinate, vertex, path shape, length, or bearing as exact. Google imagery coords differ from the phone GPS by several meters. USE ONLY AS SEEDS: snap each landmark/apex to the nearest point on the real GPS track and validate by data (S/F gate via lap-time RMSE; pit exit/entrance via speed/heading; corner apexes via curvature/heading-rate peaks). The pit-lane LineStrings are coarse few-vertex sketches of which side the route loops, NOT a smooth or accurate path. Direction of travel is counterclockwise (turn order T1..T11).
